what: Every adapter trained for this report, indexed by condition type, condition-holding share and optimiser budget.
how: Generated by src/family_manifest.py from each run's train_meta.json plus the raw paired generations. No value here is hand-entered.
note: condition_holding_share is the positive share of RECOMMENDATION conversations, excluding benign filler. scored_sides says which sides of the conditional were actually evaluated -- an entry with only 'positive' is one a standard test could call a null without ever generating the cell where a suppression gate would show.
